a: क्रौंचः — [क्रुंच् प्रज्ञा˚ अण्] 1 A curlew, heron; मनोहरक्रौंचनिनादितानि सीमांतराण्युत्सुकयंति चेतः Rs. 4. 8; Ms. 12. 64. --2 N. of a mountain (said to be the grandson of Himālaya and said to have been pierced by Kārtikeya and Paraśurāma); हंसद्वारं भृगुपतियशोवर्त्म यत् क्रौंचरंभ्रं Me. 57. --Comp. --अदनं the fibres of the stalk of a lotus. --(नी) the seed of the lotus. --अरातिः, --अरिः, --रिपुः {1} an epithet of Kārtikeya. {2} of Paraśurāma. --दारणः, --सूदनः an epithet (1) of Kārtikeya (2) of Paraśurāma.

v: krOYca

puMstrI॰ kudf + vArTe prajYA॰ aR । (ko~cavaka) vakaBede striyAm aRantatvAt NIp । “niSamya rudatIM krOYcIm” rAmA॰ bA॰ 2 a॰ । striyAM wAp iti vadan BarataScintyaH । ajAdizu kruYcaSabdasyEva pAWAt SrImAn krOYconAma mahAgiriH । parvvatapravaraH putro nAnAratnasamanvitaH” । 3 dvIpaBede 4 asuraBede । “krOYce (dvIpe) krOYcohatodEtyaH krOYcAdrO hemakandare । skandena yudDvA suciraM citramAyI sumAyinA । sa SElastasya dEtyasya KyAtaScitreRa karmmaRA । ketutAmagamattasya nAmnA krOYcaH sa ucyate” mfgendrasaMhitA । krOYcadEtyaSca mayadAnavaputraH yaTAha hari॰ 47 a॰ “mayo dadarSa mAyAvI dAnavAndivi dAnavaH । sa SilAjAlavitatAM gaRqaSElAdfhAsinIm । pAdapotkfzwakUwAgrAM kandarAkIrRakAnanAm siMhavyAGragaRAkIrRAM nadantIM dEtyayUTapEH । IkzArmfgagaRAkIrRAM pavanA GUrRitadrumAm । samudrovE krOYcadvIpena saMvftaH । krOYcadvIpo mahABAga । SrUyatAYcAparo mahAn । kuSadvIpasya vistArAd dviguRo yasya vistaraH । krOYcadvIpe dyutimataH putrAH sapta mahAtmanaH । tamnAmAni ca varzARi tezAYcakre mahIpatiH । kuSalo mandagaScozRaH pIvaro'TAnDakArakaH । muniSca dunduBiScEva saptEte tatsutA mune! । tatrApi devaganDarvvasevitAH sumanoramAH । varzAcalA mahAbudDe! tezAM nAmAni me SfRu । krOYcaSca vAmanaScEva tftIyaScAnDakArakaH । caturToharaSElaSca svaBABirBAsayannaBaH । devAvft paYcamaScEva taTAnyaH puRqarIkavAn । dunduBiSca mahAkrOYco dviguRaste parasparam । dvIpA dvIpezu ye SElA daDimaRqodakaScApi SAkadvIpena saMvftaH । krOYcadvIpasya vistArAddviguRena mahAmate!” । “taTA vahiH krOYcadvIpo dviguRRaH svamanena kzIrodena parita upakxptaH । vfto yaTA kuSadvIpo Gftodena । yasmin v: krOYcaranDra

na॰ krOYcasya ranDram । mAnasasTahaMsanirgamamArge krOYcaparvvatasTe ranDre “haMsadvAraM BfgupatiyaSovartma yat krOYcaranDram” meGa॰ । “mAnasasTAyinohasAH krOYcaranDreRa saYcarante ityAgamaH” malli॰ krOYcAdiva haMsanivaho nirjagAma guRagaRaH” kAda॰ । tacca ranDraM paraSurAmeRa kftaM gaTA meGadUtavyAKyAne mallinATaAha “purA kila Bagavato devAt DUrjjaweH Danurupanizadam aDIyAnena Bfgunandanena skandasya spardDayA krOYcaM SiKariRam atiniSitaviSiKamuKena helayA mftpiRqa BedaM BittvA tataH krOYcaBedAdeva sadyaHsamujjfmmite kasminnapi yaSaHkzIraniDO niKilamapi jagajjAlam AplAvitamiti” kaTA SrUyate” ।
m: क्रौञ्च—रन्ध्र n. the Krauñca pass (split by the deity Kārttikeya and by Paraśu-rāma), Megh.
क्रौञ्च—रिपु m. ‘enemy of the Krauñca mountain’ = -दारण, Pañcat.

v: krOYcasUdana

pu॰ krOYcaM mayadEtyasutaM sudayati sfda--Rica--lyu । kArttikeye tasya taTAtvaM krOYcaSabde mfgendrasaMhitAvA kyAt jYeyam “sa te skandaH prasIdatu” ityupakrame “ramyadrivyavapurdevaH pAtu tvAM krOYjasUdanaH” suSrute uktam । krOYcanisUdakAdayo'pyatra “fzaBadvIpamAsAdya sevyaM krOYcanisUdakam । sarasvatyAmupaspfSya vimAnasTo virAjate” BA॰ va॰ 84 a॰
m: क्रौञ्च—सूदन m. id., Suśr.
क्रौञ्च—वन n. N. of a town, R. vii, 59, 20.

v: krOYcavat
pu॰ krOYcAH vakaBedA bAhulyena santyatra matup masya vaH । parvvataBede “kElAsaM krOYcavantaM ca taTAdriM ganDamAdanam” hari॰ 202 a॰ । krOYcayuktamAtre tri॰ striyAM NIp ।
m: क्रौञ्च—वत् m. N. of a mountain (= क्रौञ्च), Hariv. 11447.
क्रौञ्चिकी-पुत्र m. N. of a teacher, ŚBr. xiv, 9, 4, 32.
क्रौलायन m. patr. fr. क्रोल (for ˚ड), Pravar. (क्रोल्˚ MS.)
क्रौलायन See क्रौड.
क्रौड mf(ई)n. (fr. क्रोड), belonging to a hog, BhP. ii, 7, 1
coming from a hog, VarBṛS.
(= वाराह) relating to Viṣṇu's Avatār as a hog, BhP. xi, 4, 18
क्रौड m. pl. the school of Kroḍa, Pat. on Pāṇ. iv, 2, 66, Vārtt. 6.
क्रौडि m. patr. fr. क्रोड, Pāṇ. iv, 1, 80.
क्रौड्या f. of ˚डि, ib.
क्रौर्य n. (fr. क्रूर), cruelty, fierceness, hard-heartedness, Mn. xii, 33; Śak. vii; VarBṛS.; Kathās. cvi, 130 (pl.)
terribleness, W.
क्रौष्टायन v.l. for ˚ष्ट्रायण.
क्रौष्ट्रायण m. patr. fr. क्रोष्टृ, g. अरीहणादि.
क्रौष्ट्रायणक mfn. fr. ˚यण, ib.

v: krOzwrAyaRya

puMstrI॰ prakftigrahaRe liNgaviSizwasyApi grahaRAt kroztryA gotrApatyam kuYjA॰ cPaY tataH svArTe astriyAm Yya । krOzwrAyaRyaH krozwu gotrotpannastriyAgotrApatye । bahuzu yaskA॰ luka । krOzwrAyaRAH tadgotrApatyezu । tataH arIhaRA॰ caturarTyAm vuY । krOzwrAyaRaka tannivfttAtO tri॰ ।

m: क्रौष्ट्र mfn. fr. क्रोष्ट्रि, Pat. on Pāṇ. vii, 2, 117, Vārtt. 1.
क्रौष्टुकीय m. a prince of the warrior-tribe called Krauṣṭukis, Pāṇ. v, 3, 116; Kār.
क्रौष्टुकर्ण mfn. coming from Kroṣṭukarṇa g. तक्षशिलादि.

v: krOzwuki
puMstrI॰ krozweva svArTe ka tasyApatyam iY । 1 krozwukarzerapatye striyAM NIp । 2 fziBede pu॰ । “tatko draviRodAH? indra iti krOzwukiH” nirukta॰ 8, 2
m: क्रौष्टुकि m. patr. fr. क्रोष्टुक N. of a grammarian, Nir. viii, 2; Bṛh.
of an astrologer, AV.Pariś.; VarBṛS. i, 11, Sch.
m. pl. N. of a warrior-tribe belonging to the Trigarta-ṣaṣṭhas, Pāṇ. v, 3, 116; Kār.
